catalog_description: License entitlements granting the right to use a software title, with vendor, purchased count, license model, term, and renewal date.
Canonical software products in the catalog, with vendor, edition, family, and version range, separate from installations and licenses.
Connections to upstream systems, holding authentication method, sync schedule, capture state, and connector type.
Raw records pulled from source systems before match and merge, preserving origin and source identifier for lineage.
Git repositories hosted on the platform, with name, default branch, visibility, language, owner, and last activity.
Routing decisions choosing which warehouse fulfills which order line, with rationale and a confidence score.
Competitive bidding processes (RFI, RFQ, RFP, or reverse auction), tracking scope, suppliers, scorecards, responses, and the awarded supplier.
Reports on actual office occupancy and usage, covering peak patterns, underutilized zones, and utilization rates to guide space optimization.
Stockroom counts and procurement of replacement hardware components not yet deployed as assets.
Rules authorizing spend before a purchase, such as card limits, vendor restrictions, and approval matrices.
Approval requests raised before a purchase, for a virtual card, raised limit, vendor bill, or reimbursement budget, from draft to spent.
Investor commitments to a special purpose vehicle, typically a small investor base with a single capital call at close.
Single-deal investment vehicles with a limited investor base, the common structure for smaller deals.
Visual plans of building floors and suites showing current occupants, lease expirations, vacant space, and combinability options.
Staffing agency and managed-service relationships, with preference tier, performance scorecard, service agreement, and recruiter roster.
Sterilization records for reusable surgical instruments, capturing cycle parameters, batch, and quality certification before a procedure.
Land or trailer storage spaces for vessels kept ashore, with location, size, and the assigned vessel.
Daily and per-shift store operational checklists for opening, closing, safety, cleanliness, and loss prevention, with sign-off records.
In-store compliance and operational audits covering health and safety, merchandising, inventory accuracy, and point of sale.
Orders fulfilled by in-store pickup, tracking the assigned store, hold window, and pickup status.
Tasks assigned to retail associates, such as shelf stocking, planogram execution, cleaning, reconciliation, and safety checks.
Mappings between a rental listing and an external booking channel, with sync status for rates and availability.
Messages in the unified guest inbox tied to a reservation, inbound or outbound across any channel.
Guest profiles with contact details, identity and verification status, and stay history across reservations.
Cleaning and turnover tasks scheduled against a listing, usually triggered by checkout and assigned to a cleaner or team.
Rental units as marketed to booking channels, with address, amenities, capacity, house rules, photos, and availability.
Records of occupancy and lodging tax collected on a reservation, with filing and remittance to the taxing jurisdiction.
Periodic owner statements showing booking revenue, commissions, pass-through expenses, and the net payout to a property owner.
Local short-term-rental permits for a listing, with permit number, jurisdiction, issue and expiry dates, and status.
Owners whose properties a manager operates, with contact details, management agreement, commission terms, and payout details.
Pricing configurations for a listing, covering base and seasonal rates, dynamic pricing rules, fees, and stay-length limits.
Guest stays booked against a listing, with dates, booking channel, party size, pricing, and payment and check-in status.
Reviews left after a stay, by a guest about a listing or a host about a guest, synced across channels.
Multi-quarter programs aligned to corporate strategy, bundling related projects with an executive sponsor and benefits plan.
Containers grouping strategic initiatives by business unit, product line, or cost center, with aggregate KPIs and investment rules.
Decisions captured during operating reviews and strategy off-sites, such as priority changes, reallocation, and initiative go or no-go.
Strategy-map visualizations linking strategic pillars to objectives, initiatives, and measures across financial, customer, process, and learning views.
Subject access request tickets under GDPR Article 15, tracking requester, scope, fulfillment status, and regulator deadline.
Sublease grants, consents, commencements, and terminations, each with its own financial lifecycle apart from the head lease.
Insurer efforts to recover paid losses from a liable third party, with claim reference, demand amount, status, and recovery amount.
Executed legal subscription packages for an investor commitment: the signed agreement, side documents, and version history.
Bench plans for critical positions, listing identified successors, readiness ratings, development plans, and risk of loss.
Supplier-issued certifications such as food safety, organic, kosher, halal, allergen statements, and insurance coverage, with expiry tracking.
Supplier ESG performance profiles, with questionnaire responses, audit results, certifications, and Scope 3 estimates, refreshed annually.
Single resolved supplier identities consolidated across all source systems through match, merge, and survivorship.
Supplier-issued invoices for delivered goods or services, matched against purchase order and receipt before approval for payment.
Onboarding workflows for new suppliers, covering invitation, registration, document collection, and approval chain.
Risk and compliance profiles for active suppliers, including sanctions screening, financial health, ESG scoring, and certifications.
Risk-scoring records per supplier across operational, financial, and cyber dimensions.
Weighted performance ratings of suppliers over a period, scoring on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, and savings delivered.
Vendor master records, holding legal name, tax id, addresses, payment terms, contacts, currency, status, and risk profile.
Contact-center interactions (call, chat, video, callback), capturing duration, channel, agent, customer, and resolution status.
Survey program definitions for engagement, pulse, lifecycle, and 360 feedback, with audience, question set, frequency, and anonymity floor.
Individual employee responses to a survey, aggregated under anonymity thresholds and never exposed individually to managers.
Proactive end-to-end tests run against an app from a geographic location, capturing status, latency, SSL validity, and response payload.
Calibration sessions where managers normalize performance ratings across groups to reduce bias and meet distribution constraints.
Links between candidates and talent pools, carrying added date, source, status in the pool, match score, and last engagement.
Curated pools of candidates kept warm for future roles, such as past finalists, alumni, and hard-to-fill skill clusters.
Rule-based pool definitions over candidates that automatically populate membership from a saved filter.
Named, approved lists of accounts to pursue in the plan period, handed off to CRM and the ABM platform.
Taxing jurisdictions (federal, state, provincial, or local) with their rate tables, deposit schedules, and reporting forms.
Periodic statutory submissions to a tax authority, covering payment and reporting, where failure carries penalties.
Tax returns managed by a preparer, with tax year, return type, client, status, filing method, and refund or balance due.
SEO issues found by crawling, such as robots blocks, missing canonicals, duplicate content, slow pages, and structured-data errors.
Evaluations of how well an application's tech stack aligns with enterprise standards and vendor roadmaps, with score, gaps, and remediation.
Vendor platforms and tech stacks, with version, end-of-life date, upgrade status, and org-wide instance count.
Subscriber bills combining rated usage, subscriptions, and tax lines, with billing-period summary and payment status.
Commercial service offerings with technical specifications, rate plans, and SLA terms, serving as the telecom service catalog master.
Service provisioning orders to activate, modify, suspend, or deactivate a service, with customer, requested date, status, and fulfillment workflow.
Active service instances per subscriber, such as a mobile line, fiber connection, or leased circuit.
Commercial-tenant financial health records covering payment history and default risk, used to underwrite leasing decisions.
Tenant-submitted maintenance issues tracked from intake through vendor dispatch to resolution, with photos, urgency, and message thread.
Carved sales territories defining the accounts and geography assigned to a rep or team.
Reusable test definitions with preconditions, steps, expected results, tags, and traceability to requirements and suites.
Defects discovered during testing, with reproduction steps, environment, severity, priority, assigned developer, and status.
Configured environments where tests run (OS, browser, device, tenant version, database state), enabling matrix testing.
Master planning documents scoping test coverage, timeline, resources, environments, and entry and exit criteria for a release.
Single executions of a test case or suite against an environment, with outcome, duration, tester, and failure logs.
Groupings of test cases by feature, release, or type, enabling batch execution and organized reporting.
Clock-in, clock-out, and break events from a device, app, or manual entry; approved entries feed payroll.
Accrual and entitlement rules for a leave type by country, role, and tenure, with caps, carry-over, and conversion rules.
Configured integrations to external delivery tools from which work items and events are mirrored into the value-stream model.
Scheduled property showings with lock-box codes, access windows, agent attendance, and follow-up tracking.
Lot and batch identifiers under food traceability rules, linking upstream sources to downstream consignees.
Labeled document samples used to train or fine-tune extraction models, with document type, sample count, and labeling progress.
Inspection-ready training evidence packages, bundling the signed roster, certificate hash, content version, and signature record for regulators.
Reservations of a physical or virtual room and its resources for an instructor-led session.
Data transformation jobs holding mappings, functions, validation rules, and masking policies, sometimes delegating to external compute.
Imported travel itineraries (air, hotel, ground) with pre-trip approval and post-trip expense reconciliation.
Rules governing what travelers may book, covering fare classes, advance-purchase windows, preferred suppliers, spend caps, and out-of-policy handling.
Per-traveler records holding seat and meal preferences, loyalty memberships, travel documents, and emergency contacts.
Pre-trip authorization requests and their decisions, routed for out-of-policy, over-budget, or high-risk trips, with justification.
Single reservations (flight, hotel, rail, or car) with confirmation, fare or rate, ancillaries, and ticketing status.
Ordered sets of travel segments for a trip, assembled from reservations and kept in sync as segments change or are disrupted.
Returned sets of bookable options for a shopping request, aggregated from multiple content sources and ranked against travel policy.
Client trust-account ledgers with per-client and per-matter balances, three-way reconciliation evidence, and retention rules.
Residual value from unused or partly used tickets that can be reapplied to a future booking, tracked through available, reapplied, and expired states.
Metered usage inputs (events, consumption units, overage credits) that feed usage-based pricing and billing aggregation.
